analysis:
Actual ordinary VP8 color+mask WebCodecs reconstruction recovers all3alpha frames exactly versus originalRGBA; native transparentWebM comparator within0.506premultipliedRGB. Wrong timestamps rejected, candidate decoder reset/close and native backward seek/EOF checked. Nine alternating first-frame jobs median paired ratio 0.242x versus native element load+seek, including setup/cleanup. This is a prepared32x32alpha destination capability and API job latency finding, not hardware throughput or arbitrary HDR qualification.

Unsupported alpha represented by independent opaque VP8 color+mask streams with explicit exact timeline/dimension pairing and originalRGBA oracle. HDR and arbitrary stream synchronization excluded.
